text:
Prof. Ansel Okafor led the excavation at Tel Maridun, which closed its final season on 14 October 2019, according to the project's final report.

A team of 42 researchers and volunteers uncovered 311 catalogued artifacts over the course of the work. The findings are set out in the *Tel Maridun Final Excavation Report* (Maridun Antiquities Authority, Publication No. 27), which was presented at the 2020 Eastern Levant Archaeology Symposium.

Dr. Liora Venkataraman, senior ceramicist and deputy field director, confirmed Prof. Okafor's leadership of the dig.

"Prof. Okafor directed the excavation from start to finish, and the final report reflects the work of the whole team under his guidance," Venkataraman said.

The report is now part of the Antiquities Authority's published record.
